# orders
Orders service on PostgreSQL. Migrations in db/migrations, run by the project's migration tool.
files.db/migrations/persistence-modes.yaml:
database: postgresql 17
migrations: db/migrations
strategies:
  unit_of_work: src/orders/unit_of_work.py
  tenancy:
    strategy: none
tables:
  order_events:
    mode: append-only
    history: none
    projection: orders_current
    rebuild_test: tests/test_orders_projection.py
    refusal: grant
files.src/orders/events.py:
def append(conn, order_id, kind):
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO order_events (order_id, kind) VALUES (%s, %s)", (order_id, kind))

cases.brief:

files.README.md:
# notes
A notes service on PostgreSQL 17. Migrations in db/migrations. No decision records yet.

cases.brief:
mode: design
checkout: the current directory
database: PostgreSQL 17
model: the OLTP layer of the notes service. The domain layer in src/notes/model.py has two aggregates, Notebook (a person renames it) and Note (a person edits its body). Every row carries the workspace_id of the customer that owns it. Queries: list a workspace's notebooks by title; list a notebook's notes, newest first. Design the persistence.

# billing
Billing service on MySQL 8.4. Migrations in db/migrations, applied in order by the migration tool, each file in one transaction.
